spec.name: Orange Kitchen Iced Coffee
spec.description: A stepped warm-ivory ceramic mug with an open orange handle, dark iced coffee and three chunky blue ice cubes. Stepped walls and a raised rim give the cup a rounded vanilla silhouette; its foot rests at y0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Iced Coffee. Small stepped ceramic coffee mug with a proper open handle, appropriate dark coffee or milk surface and latte foam detail when relevant. Actual recipe ingredients: coffee grounds, water bottle, ice. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
